summary: A wide set of WebRTC API improvements landed to give web apps clearer errors and richer transport/media information: DTLS and SCTP failures now surface as RTCError (DTLS is the secure handshake for media, SCTP powers data channels), DTLS role is marked "unknown" before negotiation, and a selected ICE candidate-pair API plus outbound‑rtp stats are implemented so apps can inspect which network path and bitrate/packet metrics are actually used. RTP/codec handling was cleaned up—RTCRtpParameters now include RTCP and headerExtensions details and header-extension lists were normalized—helping apps and sites implement advanced features like simulcast and header-based metadata more reliably. **Overall, this gives developers better diagnostics and more complete connection and media stats for real-time audio, video, and data.**
